qualification.details: Deputy Director: Post Graduate Degree in Humanities, Science or Education from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 5 years experience of working with children and research experience from a recognized Institution in the field of child psychology or enhancement of creativity amongst children, supported by documents/list of publications. Good knowledge of English and Hindi. Assistant Director (Science): M. Sc. from a recognized University. Minimum 8 years experience of working with children in a reputed Institution. Good knowledge of English & Hindi. Scientific temper and ability to exploit inexpensive resources for conducting various science activities/programme. Sensitivity to environmental issues. Curator (Museum): Graduate from a recognized University. Degree in Museology. 5 years experience of working in a Museum. Should be able to plan and design innovative exhibitions for children. Good knowledge of English and Hindi.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for National Bal Bhavan Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.nationalbalbhavan.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 26-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for National Bal Bhavan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications for the National Bal Bhavan Recruitment 2026 is 26th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for the posts released by National Bal Bhavan?
faq.answer: Applications for the National Bal Bhavan Recruitment 2026 must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form from the official website and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q3. What is the official website for National Bal Bhavan?
faq.answer: The official website for National Bal Bhavan is www.nationalbalbhavan.nic.in. You can find all relevant information and download the application form from here.

faq.question: Q4. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for various posts including Deputy Director, Assistant Director (Science), and Curator (Museum).

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for the Curator (Museum) post?
faq.answer: For the Curator (Museum) post, a Graduate degree from a recognized University along with a Degree in Museology is required. Additionally, 5 years of experience in a museum is necessary.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Deputy Director position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Deputy Director post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Director (Science) post?
faq.answer: The Assistant Director (Science) post offers a salary in Pay Level-10, ranging from Rs. 56100 to Rs. 177500, with a Grade Pay of Rs. 5400.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for National Bal Bhavan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 1000/- for all categories applying for the National Bal Bhavan Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the posts in National Bal Bhavan Recruitment 2026 will primarily involve an Interview/Interaction with the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent to the Director, National Bal Bhavan, Kotla Road, New Delhi-110002, as mentioned in the official notification.
